# Honeybadger

Honeybadger is an error tracking and application performance monitoring service for developers.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/honeybadger/.

## Actions

- **Report Check-In**: Report a check-in (ping) to Honeybadger.
- **Report Deployment**: Report a new deployment to Honeybadger.
- **Report Event**: Send custom events to Honeybadger Insights.
- **Report Exception**: Report an exception notice to Honeybadger.
- **Upload File to S3**: Upload a local file to a managed S3 bucket.
- **Upload Source Map**: Upload JavaScript source maps for error de-minification.
